cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Choose What Matters More
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between emotional safety and the outcome they claim to want.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before we renew this lease, do you want my honest answer about living together or a peaceful dinner? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your honest answer. Just don't say anything that makes me panic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I can't promise both. Shall I answer, or shall we order?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Answer. But start by saying we're fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the answer you're choosing for me. Do you still want mine?

mechanism: A manages a lease discussion while adjusting its timing, forcing B to choose an honest answer over a guaranteed peaceful evening.
confusable: Unlike simply announcing upsetting truth, A asks B to choose whether to risk hearing it; S02 keeps the discussion cooperative through timing concessions.
comparison: Shared housing and emotional truth differ from taking a public performance risk with an escort.
seedUse: D106-b honest lease answer and requested reassurance; S02-a negotiated sequencing without borrowing rank slogans.
